title: Docx Markdown Fidelity Report
summary: Convert DOCX to Markdown and list every item that needs review.
user: Teams inheriting Word-heavy documentation who need to convert it to Markdown while knowing exactly which tables, tracked changes, comments, images, and styles need human review.
smallest_useful_product: Local CLI that converts DOCX directly to Markdown and emits a per-file fidelity report listing tables, comments, revisions, embedded objects, footnotes, styles, and image extraction outcomes.
success_measure: Every unsupported or lossy construct is reported with its source location before output is accepted.
constraints: Treat documents as untrusted; do not execute embedded content; preserve filenames safely; no OCR, document editing, PDF round-tripping, or hosted conversion.
